audit: Independent read-only source and CPU baseline audit
findings: CPU models/osm-pca.json and osm-clusters.json are all-cell deployment refits. Evaluator independently fits train-only PCA and KMeans instead.
CPU bootstrap interval averages blocks equally whereas headline MSE averages cells. Independent report labels both estimands and resamples complete spatial blocks.
Training cell log1p count features differ in spatial support from 1.5km-circle named-place density inference features.
Spatial blocks have no buffer, mapping coverage is incomplete, and OSM IDs need not identify distinct physical facilities.
Unverified rental data and predictions are excluded from the experimental package.
